reviews.title: LOVED IT
reviews.text: First of all this was amazing I had amazing food seats felt like first class it had so many shows Quality was great baggage claim was so kind and The spring water was amazing for spring water and it came with blankets to sleep on and the game selection was great Legroom was not great but good for economy
reviews.author: Second A

reviews.title: Good friendly service
reviews.text: This was my first time with Finnair. I was impressed by the organized and pleasant service I received. It was a short flight but quite pleasant and smooth. I had no luggage issues such as damage or issue with hand luggage. All went well. I will recommend Finnair to all.
reviews.author: Coryy20

reviews.title: Extremely poor service. Wish I could give 0 stars.
reviews.text: What a pathetic service by your airline of such repute. Ideally, the checkin for flights start 3.5-4 hours prior, but I guess you go by other rules which you don’t even mention on your website, during web checkin or your e-ticket. Because it’s an international flight, we reached the airport 3.5 hours prior thinking that the checkin should start anytime now and we will also get ample time to shop from duty free. But, no, it’s been more that an hour that all the passengers have been standing in the queue and the checkin hasn’t even started. hell, there’s not even a single employee of Finnair to keep us updated. Our flight is in 2 hours. With the security checkin and immigration, there won’t be any time left for us in the terminal. The same happened with us from Delhi to Oslo flight. This is so not done. If you claim to be a professional airline, then you guys should better act like one and work on your damn services in a more efficient way. Don’t waste our time like that. It’s really not okay. It’s high time you should treat your clients as your priority and provide quality services to us. We don’t fly with you for free. You charge a hell lot of money from us.
reviews.author: Radhika

reviews.title: Racist in first Business Class and Finnair allowed it!
reviews.text: Me and my fammily were travelling from Vienna to Helsinki by Finnair this week. We were on the priority line with my son who is 4 years old, husband and elderly parents (my father had a head injuried and was bandaged) waiting on the priority checking line. We were the third passengers in line. Suddenly out of nowhere a man jump on the line in front of us. We asked him what he was doing and he said he had ''priority'' and that he was waiting for long in the line. I understand that ''priority'' also means people who paid more for an early checking but also we had priority because we traveled with a child and sick elderly parents. I asked him to move and he laugh at me, later my husband very politely asked him the same and this man look at him and told him ''shut up!'' The family who was first on the line that saw all asked us to come forward but the second passenger in line didn't want to let us in. In the end we all started arguing because of this man who got in the queue. I started to cry and when we got to the counter my husband told the Finnair attendants what had happened, that this man had jumped the queue and they did nothing about it. What caught our attention very much is that this man did not stand in front of the first passengers nor the second passenger who were all WHITE, but in front of us who are a Hispanic/Indian family in a clear act of racism and discrimination which also Finnair allowed it! Never again!
reviews.author: Trilce Garcia

reviews.title: Extremely disappointed
reviews.text: We had 4 sectors with this flight Del hel ( premium economy Hel nap ( economy Vie hel ( economy Hel del ( premium economy Delhi airport staff was the worst. The main supervisor girl was running like a headless chicken, no clear answer given to anything we asked, No priority check in for premium economy No priority boarding , she was rude when we asked about the same How ever in hel on our return they did have priority boarding which was zone wise , But vie airport took almost 1:15 min to clear us. Such long que n mismanaged staff. The boy who checked us in almost took 15 min with some confusion on name which he didn't understand. Over all a very stressed experience with the airline. The cabin crew for both sectors were really good.
reviews.author: sR1316

reviews.title: Pleasant Riga flights
reviews.text: We bought inexpensive round-trip Campaign Light tickets to Riga at 90 euros per person. As Finnair Gold members, we had all the extra perks which normally are not included in Economy Light tickets. The complimentary lounge access was the biggest advantage. The lounge in Riga is an excellent place to wait for your flight. The flights were fully booked. The new superlight concept was not visible anyway. The overhead compartments came full and the last passengers had difficulties to find space. I had anticipated this and checked in our bigger hand baggage. Before Finnair Gold members have been in boarding group 1 on all ATR flights because there is no business class on these flights. Now we were in group 2 as was at least half of the plane. I wouldn't call this priority boarding. On the way back, the flight landed 28 minutes late. The inbound aircraft was changed in Helsinki, probably because of some technical problems.
reviews.author: Mikael F

reviews.title: Fuc**** wifi
reviews.text: Wifi is a fuc**ng scam I would wante to just update Netflix to watch someting that I allready had downloaded but no I can't bacause a*s wifi service doesn't let you do anything but browse web...
reviews.author: Tommi S

reviews.title: Flight attendant ready to kill
reviews.text: I'm flying with you 10 times a month sometimes just one more last thing the lady's flight attendant so rude and disrespectful they work in a way like the hate everyone and all and ready to kill especially last flight I mean the one 22:30 or 23:00
reviews.author: Davin

reviews.title: Pleasant and affordable flight to Stockholm
reviews.text: The Economy Light one-way ticket was just 55 euros per person. As Finnair Gold members, we had priority check-in, checked luggage, priority security, access to the lounge, priority boarding, and complimentary seat selection. The flight was on time. The service was very friendly.
reviews.author: Mikael F

reviews.title: My best flight experience in YEARS!
reviews.text: First of all: I fly a lot with working onboard cruise ships. One year i clocked 80 hours pre covid Time to rate FinnAir. Flight from Reykjavik Iceland to Rome. 1 connecting. First, had to wait 3 hours before service desk opened. Unable to complete baggage at kiosk or online. Need signage But Due to is an amazingly awesome incredibly helpful lady at service desk. She was soooo nice, sweet & was able to use Seaman’s book for Free luggage!!! I wish i knew her name! Shw showed incredible patience and kindness. Took time to research. Then... i got to have an enjoyable wait time with live music in Reykjavik airport!!!!!******* 3 peace band in the atrium. . NEVER seen this inside security. The gate agents only open 15 minutes before boarding.... i was first in line. While the company pays for flights. You must pay extra if you want to sit. No free seats... until moments before.... Gate agent was the same incredible woman from before.!!! I struck gold. Young, thin, brunette. Soft spoken. She gave me zone 2. An aisle seat on the first flihjt aaaand window exit row on 2nd flight. I wish i could nominate her for team member of the month. Any suggestions???? Especially without knowing her name. Cruise ships always recognize star employees. She was super patient with elderly family behind me upset cause they couldn't sit together. Both Flights depart & arrive on time. WITH ALLL my luggage. *******Best flight in years!!! GO FINAIR!!
reviews.author: Christiek

reviews.title: Kind of bad....not that good...really mediocre at best.
reviews.text: We were really negatively impressed by Finnair. Food was very, very bad in our estimation, and I remember broken fixtures in the plane's bathroom. We don't ever want to fly on Finnair again.
reviews.author: Woodrew Wilson

reviews.title: Average european flight experience from Amsterdam
reviews.text: During my 3 days exhibition visit in Amsterdam, I used mix-flights, where return back to home was Finnair's direct flight from AMS to HEL. Direct flights are my favorites, so it was this time, also. Nice feeling to get back home! Timetables were very suitable for my trip (last day at exhibition, no hurry to get yourself into Airport). Finnair had handy slot & parking place at T1. They didn't seem to have any hurry up, so both passenger and luggage loadings happened at the same time. But it took near half an hour to get all passengers fully seated (which means 6 pax/min, poor result), and all this happened by passenger queuing, WITHOUT social distances (not optimized). As economy class customer, you must pay for meals etc,, so feelings like "those airliners are looking like each others", not so big differences. But flight went well and Cabin Crew was very polite & willing to serve.
reviews.author: JaakkoTapio

reviews.title: Feel Cheated
reviews.text: We travelled with Finnair from Singapore to Helsinki Business Class and have absolutely no complaints about the trip. Everything was great from the food, service and comfort of the seat/bed. Having had this wonderful experience, we were shocked that we then had a terrible experience from Helsinki to Malaga. I know this is a short haul flight, 4 hours and 30 minutes, but it was on the same ticket so we expected the same level of service and comfort. We were so wrong!!! I don't know how they can get away with charging customers a Business Class fare for Economy Class seats!!! There wasn't even media facilities. So if a passenger didn't bring a tablet or anything to read, then you had to stare at the back of the seat in front of you for the entirety of the journey. Not happy at all and feel cheated.
reviews.author: hughesnadja

reviews.title: Efficient Service with Above Frills Features
reviews.text: Finnair offers the only non-stop between JFK and HEL. The aircraft was an Airbus 330. The cabin crew, all women, were professional and efficient. The lie flat seat was comfortable to sleep on though setting up the bed required a bit of work. A comforter and mattress were provided at the seat as well as two pillows. They served their purpose. On boarding we were offered a choice of champagne, water, and blue berry juice. I chose the blueberry and it was delicious. Given the late night departure, only a light supper was served. The morning breakfast was ample though entirely lacking in any originality. The selection of drinks was good —- however, the Finnish cocktails listed on the paper menu card was not available; it had not been loaded on to the plane. The entertainment system was easy to use. The collection of films was not extensive and I found only one film that I could watch — Hitchcock’s “Birds”. The amenities bag was simple and included the basic items. Slippers provided but no pajamas. Before dimming the cabin lights after supper, the cabin roof was set aglow with colors mimicking the Northern Lights — this was a very original touch which I very much appreciated. The flight arrived on schedule. Disembarking at Helsinki was smooth and quick. Overall, a very pleasant and comfortable flight. Finnair is a OneWorld member and that is a key reason I flew this airline. I was on set 5L, a window seat, the seat was angled to face the window. There is sufficient privacy but they are not suites. As QSuites on Qatar.
reviews.author: 150rajibs

reviews.title: Great Service
reviews.text: This was supposed to be a BA airline but they had sub contracted it to Finnair. What a lovely modern plane with some great happy and helpful staff and great service all round. Very impressed indeed. Thank you BA for arranging this.
reviews.author: 121chiffchaff

reviews.title: Horrible experience
reviews.text: I planned a family vacation for 6 of my family members. We had round trip tickets from El Paso to Italy and back. We barely missed our flight out of Dallas, the people at the front counter were extremely rude and didn't want to let us on the plane. The plane was scheduled to leave at 4:50, we got to the gate at 4:58. The plane was still attached to the walk way. We were going to plan on getting another flight to Italy and just fly back using our round trip tickets that were already purchased, but since we missed one flight Finnair canceled all of our flights!!! Even our return flights!! No money back, not even trying to get us on another flight. The tickets were expensive to begin with and now they just left us with no way of getting out of Dallas. I understand we missed our one flight, but we could have purchased another flight to Italy and still used our returning flights. I would highly recommend going with ANY other company!!! As long as you pay Finnair, they don't care what happens to their customers after they get your money. They will leave you stranded, not even with any options, concerns, or a solution. Worst experience ever.
reviews.author: AsiannFlower

reviews.title: Don't buy code-shared flights via Finnair. Their customer service is not 24 hrs
reviews.text: We bought economy return tickets to Japan directly from the Finnair website. It was a 'code-shared flight' with JAL and BA and cost us nearly 2,000 GBP each. The BA flight from Paris to London on the way back was suddenly canceled and we only found out when we arrived in Paris CDG after a long flight from Tokyo. We rang Finnair and they told me to contact BA. The BA refused to rebook our tickets saying it was a 'code-shared flight' and we had to contact the Finnair. By that time the Finnair customer service was closed. We had to spend over 600GBP to come back to London by Eurostar on the following day and it took us two days to locate our checked-in luggage and get them back. Both Finnair and BA are still blaming each other and I am still in the process of getting a refund. It was only JAL that helped us to identify where our luggage was and gave us a phone call and email to tell us precisely which BA flights our luggage was flown by. This means Finnair does not have a proper agreement with its alliance, BA. Why do you offer 'code-shared' flights if you don't have a proper agreement with the company and if you can't be responsible when an occasion like this happens?
reviews.author: Connector545284

reviews.title: Enjoyable flight to Rovaniemi
reviews.text: We bought one-way economy light tickets at 56 euros pp. It was excellent value because as Finnair Gold members, we got priority check-in, checked baggage, priority security, lounge access, and priority boarding. Also, we could choose our seats without an extra charge. Seats 1AC have the best legroom in Embraer 190. More than the exit row 11. The flight landed 8 minutes ahead of the schedule. The service was friendly and effective.
reviews.author: Mikael F

reviews.title: Finnair Shorthaul flights, it is quite basic
reviews.text: This was a very nice plane, it was small, so it was quite comfy, and it was not full... anyway overall it was Ok, I don't know I had more expectations for the service. But I recommend it because the crew was very friendly
reviews.author: FrankA2

reviews.title: Not really a full service airline
reviews.text: I had a trip booked with Qatar Airways, where I hold a Gold member status, to Bangkok via Doha. To my disappointment the first leg from CPH to DOH was a code share flight with One World alliance member Finnair. I have flown with Finnair to Bangkok before on the back then all new A350. This leg from CPH to DOH was on a A330, a plane I truly love for its design. Further, the seat configuration at 2-4-2 is great as long as you sit on either side of the aircraft. I had a seat with great legroom after I initially was given the worst seat, back of the plane right next to the lavatories. The entertainment screen was wall-mounted which I really liked as opposed to the fold-away in-seat entertainment screen. Service was very friendly but it is very limited and cannot compare to Qatar Airways. The food served was a nightmare (see pic). It was bland in taste and presentation was not too appealing either. All in all it is disappointing to be “downgraded” from Qatar Airways to Finnair. Finnair itself has a great ambience onboard their aircraft and very friendly staff. It is a shame their level of service cannot keep up with their good hard product. Priority boarding was ok. Enough space in the overhead luggage compartment. The inflight entertainment was not bad, but it was not good either. A rather limited choice awaits you. However, for a short 6 hour flight you should be okay.
reviews.author: Mavros41

reviews.title: Worth the price
reviews.text: Complimentary blueberry juice served aboard the flight was delicious. The legroom on the ATR was very good and the cabin was clean.
reviews.author: Pavel G

reviews.title: Enjoyable return flight from Budapest
reviews.text: Finnair changed the aircraft from Embraer to Airbus. We decided to upgrade to business class with points. Glad we did because the service was top-notch. This was the first time we could see the new service concept in European business class. The cold salad meal had been changed to a warm meal which was delicious. Champagne had been changed to a high-quality sparkling wine from Luxemburg. I am sure that nobody could have noticed the change if they haven't seen the bottle. The service was very friendly and attentive.
reviews.author: Mikael F

reviews.title: Very disappointing customer experience with Finnair.
reviews.text: Flying out of Heathrow to Helsinki for business. I was charged £26 to add ‘four’ letters to my name on my booking form at ‘Bag-drop’. Took them just a few minutes to correct. I fly regularly and I have never before been charged, and had used all their check-in tools beforehand. Staff at desk were terse and dismissive, would not explain this charge to me. Tried to seek an explanation/justification privately using their feedback process. No satisfactory follow up on this issue. I have instructed my staff not to use this airline again.
reviews.author: Tim B

reviews.title: Show no repect to its customer, cancel the return ticket while we cannot catch the first flight
reviews.text: I and my colleague booking flight AY1416 May 8th from Frankurt to Helsinki, departure time is 19:25. My colleague only took his permernent resident card instead of passport(before he flied with Lufthansa to Finland, passport was not necessary). He was denied boarding, the airline check-in staff suggested him to take the late flight by lufthansa but also not encough time because we live 2 hours away. Then I called Finnair (30 min wait online) to reschedule to next day's ticket but the line was interupted by accident so the payment was not finished, and then I cannot connect. My colleague later decided to buy a new ticket to fly with the earliest flight with Lufthansa to attend an important meeting. Then the next day we were in Helsinki, we got message that his ticket was automatically cancelled because he did not show up! This is unbelievable!!! First he did show up but was denied boarding, the second is why didn't the check-in staff in Frankfurt airport tell us? She even recommended him to take another flight by Lufthansa. I spend one hour on the phone with the service guy, he know all the stories, but cannot do anything! This is really really unacceptable!!! I understand low budget airline provide very limited service, but in this case they are absolutly wrong and rude! They show no respect at all to its customers, after knowing all the details they still insist to cancel the flight, anyone can understand this? My suggestion to everyone is stay away from Finnair.
reviews.author: Kevin Lee

reviews.title: Budget airline at premium price
reviews.text: Over the past 10 years Finnair has gone from bad to worse. They offer a low cost airline service while asking a traditional price for the ticket. You get less service for the same money. And this is Finnish 'flag carrier'. Their only benefit is that they offer direct connections. In all other regards and aspects, if you can find alternative airline - use it. It will very likely be better value for money.
reviews.author: Andrey Z

reviews.title: Terrible no meals Alicante flights even with money
reviews.text: I cant understund why its not possible to byu meals anymore. We are traveling with 2 children to Alicante and Finnair dont sell normal food anymore. Flight is 4,5 hours long an starting 7.30 am. My wife use Finnair to Milano last month and flight was shorter. With that flight it was possible to preorder warm meals. Finnair people has no any clue what people want.
reviews.author: osmo r

reviews.title: Pleasant flight to Budapest
reviews.text: This time we were able to see a 45-minute airshow through the windows of Finnair Lounge. The former Finnair's (Aero) 80-year-old DC-3 was doing constant takeoffs and landings. Our flight to Budapest with an Embraer jet was comfortable and on time. It is practical for couples that the seats are 2+2. For the same reason, it is not advisable to upgrade to business class because Finnair leaves no empty seats in Embraer if the flight is fully booked. Because of our Finnair Gold cards, we had anyway complimentary access to the lounge and some other benefits that are included in the business class ticket. The only real difference would have been the complimentary food and drink service during the flight.
reviews.author: Mikael F

reviews.title: WHAT A MEAN AIRLINE
reviews.text: We flu Finair before and it was really good. We flu yesterday May 13 2023. The crew was very nice but it is a very mean airline. A very small breakfast at 8sm and nothing in between. After 9 hours, finally lunch. No snacks. You have to pay for them. No free wifi. Never again. Thanks Carlos
reviews.author: Carlos G

reviews.title: Fully lacking on service and support to customers
reviews.text: If you have option rather than them just take it even if a low cost company. These people do not help do not take care of responsibility and if you are claiming for compensation they will literally tell you to communicate with the Finnish Competititon and Consumer Authority. They were delayed in a flight from Madrid to Bergen I lost a professional meeting but the worst was how I manage to take 3 extra flights just telling me to run to different gates. I had anxiety attacks and levels of stress that still need to stop a breath and they do not care... they just deliver you as a package with no support not understanding and not even giving you the money of the flight or compensation for 2 hours 40 min delay.... Very unprofessional personal.....
reviews.author: Jorge C

reviews.title: Unconcerned Customer Support
reviews.text: Was very disappointed with my recent experience with your customer service! As i do understand that flights get delayed and stuff happens, the lack of genuine concern for your client is unacceptable (your flight was late from Europe, therefore we could not make it to our next flight. We ended up renting a car and driving for half of the night . When we asked to reimburse rental car expenses, we received the answer that you did everything you could - offering us next flight in 23 hours (with a wait in the airport with 5 year old after 20 hour trip already), therefore "we will not reimburse you other travel expenses that you bought yourself". Just wanted to warn future travelers...
reviews.author: Rasma

reviews.title: Nice flight
reviews.text: Good flight. Needed Telephone Support for a matter. Easy to speak with someone, no long hold time. Friendly, Professional Flight Crew. Check in was easy. Luggage arrived intact.
reviews.author: C. A.

reviews.title: Great customer service
reviews.text: What a good experience from Finnair, compared to BA they are a proper airline. Polite staff, clean planes, beautiful lounge in Helsinki. Never travel with BA again if there is an alternative.
reviews.author: Rhoda S

reviews.title: Worse company ever
reviews.text: Issues on the way : 4 hours late issues on the return : 51h to make cancun paris we had to change 4 flights that's insane, nobody to speak with, you're completely alone, that's a shame a company like that souldn't exist.
reviews.author: Sébastien Badiolle

reviews.title: bad food
reviews.text: i used to really love finnair, and as ussual the staff is amazing friendly and helpfull. however the food was incredibly horrible, no choice, for a long haul flight we got for donner 1 small box of tasteless spagetti with chicken. for my son nothing, and for breakfast it was sad eggs with some soggy fried potatoe thing. and for my son we got a jar of apple sauce, my son is almost 2 he never eat those foods already, let alone at the age he is now. luckily he was sleeping the whole trip so he didnt need any of the bad food. we unfortunatly have our return flight with finnair too, i will deffenitly bring alot of our own food so we will have an enjoyable flight. this will be the last time we will use finnair.
reviews.author: liss

reviews.title: Wonderful Service and crew.
reviews.text: From the start I check in Ter 3 Zone C. I got my window seat. I did ordered my Breakfast on line same time I buy my Air ticket. The crew were very friendly wonderful flight on the new Airbus A350 feels like boeing 747. The tray table was clean nice movies to watch.
reviews.author: Rajesh Parmar

reviews.title: Misleading seatmap, poor and little food on long haul flight
reviews.text: I paid 34 euro for extra legroom. At least I was misled to believe I paid for extra legroom of 1 whole seat. See the red arrow. I contact customer service with the chat. And they told me NO REFUND. I got what I paid for. And they had no issues with people being misled?! The audacity! I made clear I did not feel understood. Customer service decided to quickly end conversation with me. On my long haul flight of 13+ hours I got breakfast. Which consisted of a small bun and a cake?! I am used to get two warm meals either pasta, rice or potato. With some veggies. Extra info: I landed in the evening around 22:00u. At least provide me a decent warm meal. This was just a terrible misleading experience. If I dont get refunded my seat I will never fly with finnair again.
reviews.author: J C

reviews.title: Enjoyable Iberia operated Finnair flight
reviews.text: Finnair uses Iberia planes on its flights to Barcelona and Madrid. We bought round-trip Economy Campaign Light tickets to Barcelona at 157 euros per person and upgraded with points to business class. On Barcelona flights, there are no drinks or food on sale in economy class. Probably because of the runaway used for take-offs in Barcelona is quite short (2660 m) and the plane has weight restrictions. So there is a limited amount of catering stuff that can be taken along. In business class, you get full service. A complimentary three-course meal was served and drinks throughout the flight. I am not quite sure but I think that the food was from Finnair Catering. On this flight, there were no menus like on the Madrid flight which we had 6 weeks ago. The service was friendly and attentive. The plane landed in Barcelona 15 minutes ahead of schedule.
reviews.author: Mikael F

reviews.title: Very enjoyable flight with friendly and courteous staff and crew
reviews.text: We were very pleasantly surprised by the ease of flying with Finnair. Their online check-in app is great and we enjoyed a comfortable and pleasant journey.
reviews.author: The_Wilderbeast

reviews.title: Very good air crew
reviews.text: We flew with Finnair from Heathrow to Athens both ways a few days ago..British Airways used the service we think! Very nice cabin crew..polite..efficient and friendly! We were in economy and quite a squeeze..seat wise..but very clean and OK for the 3 + hour journey We noticed on exiting the aircraft both times how nice the crew were and particularly the pilots who turned around to say goodbye....something I hadn't seen before! Cabin crew had an air of calm & efficiency at all times We would fly with Finnair again but maybe upgrade our seats Thank you Finnair
reviews.author: bronda1

reviews.title: Worst cutomer service
reviews.text: The worst online agent I have ever experience. Inconsistancy information, not very helpful, said will get back to you and never done so. Fly other airline if you can.
reviews.author: jirakate m

reviews.title: Avoid the older aircrafts still have shared screens.
reviews.text: Nice friendly staff but service very slow. Seats awful (business) old aircraft. very uncomfortable. Avoid unless newer aircrafts No wifi even though it says wifi available. Food in business was really nice.
reviews.author: Pal C

reviews.title: Oulu flight with many twists but with a happy ending
reviews.text: We bought one-way tickets to Oulu. The Economy Campaign Light price was just 44 euros pp. One week later, Finnair changed the Embraer jet to an ATR72 turboprop. The departure time was changed to 20 minutes earlier. That was a quite big disappointment as we have had so many ATR flights lately. Just after arrival in the lounge on the departure morning, we were informed that this ATR flight has been canceled and we are currently being rerouted. 10 minutes later came another message that we have been changed to an earlier Airbus flight departing 40 minutes earlier than the ATR flight. Two minutes later we were informed that to compensate for the inconvenience, we have got a 17-euro voucher that can be used in any bar or restaurant at the airport by showing the boarding card. We left the lounge earlier and used the vouchers at the pub opposite the lounge for drinks that are not offered in the lounge. Luckily we had our original printed boarding cards left because the new boarding cards in our mobile phones didn't have the voucher. This new flight was on time and we arrived in Oulu one hour earlier than in our original booking.
reviews.author: Mikael F

reviews.title: 3 hour delays
reviews.text: More than 3 hours delays ! Mecanic has to make reparation on the plane while we were in it. It's impossible to have feedback from the company...
reviews.author: Tom A

reviews.title: Not recommended + beware of their standard emails + ridicolous gate staff
reviews.text: Booked return intercontinental flight with Finnair. Outbound flight late = missed all connections. Return: from SIN, nice newer aircraft. Connection flight: old aircraft, it was morning and even just coffee was not free (unlike KLM, SAS, Lufthansa etc). But the worst of this connecting flight: while waiting at the gate, a lady of their staff of not so nice manners starts complaining about my bag, that is actually fitting in their handluggage case. The lady keeps on complaining about my bag, she really couldnt give up, while tons of other people with their fat oversized trolleys were perfectly fine. Shortly after, the same complaints are directed to a girl, who also was wearing a backpack. Ridicolous! Also beware of their standard emails that might land in your inbox before departure, some of them have wrong information, unreadable formatting, or information that is not actual for your flight or ticket type. Finnair - most likely not again
reviews.author: elis

reviews.title: Excellent
reviews.text: EVerything is excellent. TV is too large and in the way. It would be nice to have a European newspaper available on this flight to read in english.
reviews.author: HameshaIndia

reviews.title: I have never been in a more cramped economy seat
reviews.text: I was flying to Tokyo for over 13 hours, and was shocked to see my economy seat. I am 183cm tall, and had zero leg room. Literally had not expected this tiny an amount of space in my worst nightmares, but that was what happened. The arm rest was pencil thin - I’ve never seen that in my life. They packed the plane as if we were animals. This should be against the law for a 13.5 hour flight. I will never fly with Finnair again unless I absolutely have to - SAS is a much better option for Asia travel.
reviews.author: M A

reviews.title: Affordable journey from Riga to Stockholm
reviews.text: This two-flight trip via Helsinki was 90 euros pp. So it was just 45 euros per flight. As Finnair Gold members, we had lounge access at Riga and Helsinki. Riga Primeclass Lounge is always a great place to wait for your flight. According to the timetable, our transfer time in Helsinki was just 70 minutes. However, the Riga flight arrived in Helsinki 30 minutes ahead of the schedule and the Stockholm flight departed 34 minutes late. So the transfer time increased to 134 minutes and we had plenty of time in the Helsinki Lounge. Finnair canceled many Embraer flights on that day because of technical inspections. So the Stockholm flight came completely full. There were at least many passengers going to Warsaw. The boarding in Helsinki was complete chaos. Many passengers didn't understand that it was a group boarding and blocked access to the automatic gates when their access was refused because they were in a different group. That was not the only cause for the late departure. This A321 aircraft had only 35 minutes turnaround time according to the timetable. Luckily, the aircraft arrived from Milan 8 minutes ahead of schedule although the captain announced that the late departure was because of the late arrival of the aircraft. It was more the cause of bad timetable planning. A fully booked A321 cannot be turned around in 35 minutes.
reviews.author: Mikael F

reviews.title: Worst flight experience ever
reviews.text: I booked a flight with FinnAir to fly Dublin Delhi via Helsinki return. The flight to Delhi went smoothly. The return flight was an absolute nightmare. When I arrived at Delhi Airport I was sent to three different FinnAir check in desks as I wasn't showing in their system. Eventually it was explained to me that I was transferred to Air India and would fly Delhi to Heathrow with a long layover. Upon arriving in Heathrow I had no boarding pass for the next leg of journey Heathrow Dublin so when going through the flight connections route within the terminal I had to explain over and over that my flight had been changed. I eventually got to the Aer Lingus desk whereby I got a boarding pass to Diblin but the staff member was unable and unhelpful to let me know if my luggage would be transferred to the Heathrow Dublin flight and said I would need to speak with Air India to confirm about my luggage. There was no Air India desk so Airport staff advised me to go to gate 47 which was a 30 min walk as there was an Air India flight boarding and the staff might be able tofind our about my luggage. They were not. I was unable to find my way back to the correct part of Airport to again speak with the Aer Lingus staff. Fortunately a very helpful Airport staff member guided me back another 30 min walk. As I was with Airport staff the Aer Lingus staff member was more helpful and said my luggage had been transferred from the Air India flight. I then paid for the Aer Lingus private lounge as I was extremely tired and stressed from all the changes and inconvenience. I have been travelling for 30+ years and have never encountered such a horrendous flying experience.
reviews.author: Babs L

reviews.title: Again to Riga
reviews.text: For us Finns, Riga and Stockholm are the least expensive Finnair destinations abroad to collect flights in order to maintain your Finnair status. Our one-way ticket was 55 euros pp. Riga has a much better lounge than Arlanda. Also, hotels are less expensive in Riga. The airport transportation in Riga is not as cheap as it used to be. Taxi to the city center is now 23-24 euros (green Baltic Taxi). The bus is much cheaper but inconvenient. Arlanda Express is 40 euros for two. The flight was fully booked also this time and the last passengers had difficulties finding space for their hand luggage. Luckily, we were in boarding group 1. The flight landed 12 minutes ahead of the schedule. The service was friendly.
reviews.author: Mikael F

reviews.title: Wonderful service
reviews.text: Travelled business class from Amsterdam to Helsinki. Staff very efficient and friendly. The meal was delicious- nicoise salad. Airport guest lounge was well serviced. Plane was clean, seats comfortable.
